in_hebrew.name: Gariepy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shepherd of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gariepy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'gara', meaning 'shepherd', and 'epe', meaning 'people'. This name is a reminder of the shepherd king David, who cared for his people and led them to God.
